q2_gaps: a descriptively modified bare kind as an argument of a kind-level relational generic ("high taxes") — the fusion rule bars fusing incidental description (size/degree) and would split it into a kind plus a separate property atom, but the two-slot kind relation has no place for that property

relational/classifying adjectives as compound modifiers ("economic" in economic_growth) — the modifier-genus rule enumerates gradable, positional/cardinal and material adjectives, and its "part of speech, not meaning" line points the other way, so whether (Inheritance economic_growth economic) is required is undetermined
notes: Both arguments are bare kind-denoting NPs, so the kind-level relation (Stifle high_tax economic_growth) at (STV 0.9 0.9) is the licensed form and Stifle is a licensed open-class kind relation; fusing high_tax is the defensible workaround for the gap above.
